newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Gold tender to be called in Argentina's Patagonia.
newsitem.headline: Gold tender to be called in Argentina's Patagonia.

text.p: An Argentine company said Friday it will call for bidders November 22 for a gold exploration and development tender for a 46,000-hectare property in the far southern region of Patagonia.

The La Josefina property is 120 km northwest of the Cerro Vanguardia gold mine being developed by Minera Mincorp SA, owned 50-50 by Luxembourg-based Minorco and local conglomerate Perez Companc, said Roberto Traba, president of mining company Fomecruz.
"There is gold in veins and we also believe that the possibility that other forms of gold formations exist should also be studied," Traba told Reuters.
Fomecruz, which also owns the site of Cerro Vanguardia, is owned by the Santa Cruz provincial government.
